import json
import math

def tile_to_coord(x, y, zoom):
    ''''''Convert tile coordinates to geographic bounds''''''
    n = 2.0 ** zoom
    lon_min = x / n * 360.0 - 180.0
    lon_max = (x + 1) / n * 360.0 - 180.0
    lat_max_rad = math.atan(math.sinh(math.pi * (1 - 2 * y / n)))
    lat_min_rad = math.atan(math.sinh(math.pi * (1 - 2 * (y + 1) / n)))
    lat_max = math.degrees(lat_max_rad)
    lat_min = math.degrees(lat_min_rad)
    return lat_max, lat_min, lon_max, lon_min  # north, south, east, west

# Expanded coverage: X: 1889-1894, Y: 1699-1708 (6x10 = 60 tiles)
tiles = []
x_min, x_max = 1889, 1894
y_min, y_max = 1699, 1708
zoom = 12

# Calculate overall bounds
overall_north, _, _, overall_west = tile_to_coord(x_min, y_min, zoom)
_, overall_south, overall_east, _ = tile_to_coord(x_max, y_max, zoom)

print(f''🌍 Generating mapping for expanded coverage:'')
print(f''   X: {x_min}→{x_max} (6 tiles wide)'')
print(f''   Y: {y_min}→{y_max} (10 tiles tall)'')
print(f''   Total: 60 tiles'')
print(f''   Overall bounds: N:{overall_north:.3f}, S:{overall_south:.3f}, E:{overall_east:.3f}, W:{overall_west:.3f}'')

# Generate tiles with UV mapping for 6x10 atlas
for y in range(y_min, y_max + 1):
    for x in range(x_min, x_max + 1):
        # Geographic bounds for this tile
        north, south, east, west = tile_to_coord(x, y, zoom)
        
        # UV bounds for 6x10 atlas
        col = x - x_min  # 0-5
        row = y - y_min  # 0-9
        u_min = col / 6.0
        u_max = (col + 1) / 6.0
        v_min = row / 10.0
        v_max = (row + 1) / 10.0
        
        tile_info = {
            ''x'': x,
            ''y'': y,
            ''zoom'': zoom,
            ''uvBounds'': {
                ''uMin'': round(u_min, 6),
                ''vMin'': round(v_min, 6),
                ''uMax'': round(u_max, 6),
                ''vMax'': round(v_max, 6)
            },
            ''geoExtent'': {
                ''north'': round(north, 6),
                ''south'': round(south, 6),
                ''east'': round(east, 6),
                ''west'': round(west, 6)
            }
        }
        tiles.append(tile_info)

# Create complete mapping
mapping = {
    ''tiles'': tiles,
    ''attribution'': ''© Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics'',
    ''totalBounds'': {
        ''north'': round(overall_north, 6),
        ''south'': round(overall_south, 6),
        ''east'': round(overall_east, 6),
        ''west'': round(overall_west, 6)
    },
    ''source'': ''Esri'',
    ''zoomLevel'': zoom,
    ''format'': ''jpg'',
    ''resolution'': 10,
    ''description'': f''Complete 6x10 grid satellite imagery covering full Lanzarote island ({x_min}-{x_max}, {y_min}-{y_max})''
}

# Save to file
with open(''lanzarote-tile-mapping-full.json'', ''w'') as f:
    json.dump(mapping, f, indent=2)

print(f''✅ Generated lanzarote-tile-mapping-full.json with {len(tiles)} tiles'')
